text:
maya: Quick shout  whos up for a tiny 3-day 'Hill & Hang' micro-challenge next week? low commit, good vibes.
maya: plan: Mon/Wed/Fri pick one  either 12min hill sprints or 12min climbing drills (hangs or movement). post proof if you want.
henry: I like short. count me in. lunchtime hill sprint for me.
lucas: climbing drills for me. will do the easy problems and some antagonists.
anya: curious  can we have a sunday makeup option for people travelling?
maya: yes, weekend makeup allowed. just mark which day you replaced.
zack: logistics: where are the hills? i only know the stairwell route.
maya: 2 options: office stairwell for quick repeats or Riverbank hill for 10-12min sessions (more vert). meet Tue 6:15 if anyone wants company.
fitness-bot: POLL: "Preferred meetup for Hill & Hang"  Options: "Office stairwell (lunch)", "Riverbank hill (after work)", "No meetup (solo)"  Vote now!
henry: voted stairwell.
lucas: voted Riverbank.
anya: voted solo.
zack: voted stairwell.
maya: scoring: 1pt per day, +1 bonus for a selfie or funny post-run gif. keep it friendly.
henry: small prize? loser provides bagels?
lucas: winner gets coffee + digital trophy. losers bring snacks lol.
anya: can we track on a tiny sheet?
maya: done: https://tinyurl.com/hill-hang-micro (names + days + optional effort 1-5).
fitness-bot: POLL RESULTS: "Preferred meetup for Hill & Hang"  Office stairwell (lunch) (2 votes), Riverbank hill (after work) (1 vote), No meetup (solo) (1 vote).
zack: ok stairwell lunchtime it is. I'll try Riverbank Tue evening if anyone's going.
maya: kickoff Monday. post a short note when you finish so we can cheer. :clap: :running_man:
